svg.title: 3.3 Members and roster
svg.desc: Wireframes for the Members page (invite, change role, deactivate) and the Roster page (week calendar, add shift, NO_PRIMARY warning), with the invite, shift and refused-deactivation dialogs and the 360 pixel mobile layouts. Illustrative sample data, not live records.
svg.text: Routes /o/members and /o/roster | Org Manager (Operator reads the roster) | Desktop views above, dialogs and 360 px mobile below
TanNB | SD | 29 Oct 2026 | Illustrative API sample data (api-design 12 to 19); alternate states are separate views.
Deactivate asks first and names the member. The last active Manager is refused by the server (view C3).
An Org Operator who opens this route sees the full-page notice MSG26.
Nobody is primary on duty Mon 20 Oct 12:00 to Tue 21 Oct 00:00.
Alerts in that window start with the backup.
primary, Thu 23 Oct 00:00 to Mon 27 Oct 00:00
Green: shift with a primary. Amber dashed: window or gap with no primary. Select a shift to edit or delete it.
Optional. Shown on alert contact cards.
C2. Add shift (UC-05), overlap refused (one error at a time)
Optional. An empty primary raises the MSG22 warning.
C3. Deactivate member (UC-04), last Manager refused
Sign-in sessions are revoked, roster slots from now on are
cleared, and any incident this member owns goes back to
The organization must keep at least one Manager.
LAST_MANAGER, 409: the server message, no SRS code
00:00 to 12:00 Pham Van D, no backup
